method.suitability: Weighted mean of available scoreable factors, followed by explicit hard caps. Missing values are excluded, never scored as zero.
method.confidence: Weighted evidence reliability across factors applicable to the evaluation mode and crop policy. Non-applicable factors are excluded; missing expected evidence contributes no confidence.
